name: zz-probe-mute-fiber
description: Diagnostic: walk the React fiber tree from the mute button up to LobbyScreen/TitleStrip and report whether muted/onToggleMute props are actually present at runtime, plus capture any error thrown by the click handler. Avoids async evals (the runner does not await promises) by stashing results on window.

steps.expression: (() => { window.__err = []; window.addEventListener('error', e => window.__err.push('error: ' + e.message)); window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', e => window.__err.push('rejection: ' + (e.reason && (e.reason.message || String(e.reason))))); const ce = console.error; console.error = function(...a) { window.__err.push('console.error: ' + a.map(x => (x && x.message) || String(x)).join(' ').slice(0, 300)); return ce.apply(this, a); }; return 'error hooks installed'; })()
steps.name: A - install error capture

steps.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-mute]'); const fk = Object.keys(b).find(k => k.startsWith('__reactFiber$')); if (!fk) return 'NO FIBER KEY - keys: ' + Object.keys(b).join(','); let f = b[fk]; const chain = []; let n = 0; while (f && n < 40) { const name = typeof f.type === 'function' ? (f.type.name || 'anon') : (typeof f.type === 'string' ? f.type : String(f.type)); if (typeof f.type === 'function') { const p = f.memoizedProps || {}; chain.push({ comp: name, hasMuted: 'muted' in p, mutedVal: p.muted, hasToggle: 'onToggleMute' in p, toggleType: typeof p.onToggleMute }); } f = f.return; n++; } return JSON.stringify(chain); })()
steps.name: B - fiber chain props (LobbyScreen/TitleStrip)

steps.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-mute]'); const pk = Object.keys(b).find(k => k.startsWith('__reactProps$')); const p = b[pk] || {}; return JSON.stringify({ hasOnClick: typeof p.onClick, ariaPressed: p['aria-pressed'], className: p.className }); })()
steps.name: C - button own props
D - state + errors right after click
E - state + errors after network settles

steps.expression: (() => { fetch('/api/trpc/user.setMuted?batch=1', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ 0: { json: { muted: true } } }) }).then(r => r.text().then(t => { window.__post = { status: r.status, body: t.slice(0, 400) }; })).catch(e => { window.__post = { threw: e.message }; }); return 'POST fired'; })()
steps.name: F - fire raw setMuted POST

steps.expression: (() => { fetch('/api/trpc/user.init?batch=1').then(r => r.text().then(t => { window.__init = { status: r.status, body: t.slice(0, 600) }; })).catch(e => { window.__init = { threw: e.message }; }); return 'GET fired'; })()
steps.name: H - fire user.init read-back
I - user.init result (look for muted field)
